CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-001.say: You are honest, independent, creative, ambitious and original, deep yet sociable. You prefer honesty over diplomacy, are firm, dislike meddling, and stay loyal.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-002.say: You are sensitive, observant and diplomatic but shy and slow to trust, and an affectionate, loyal partner. You can be moody, need emotional support, and love silence and soft music.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-003.say: You have high energy with good emotional control and strong intuition. Ruled by Jupiter, you are ambitious and social and like working independently, though sometimes scattered.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-004.say: You are self-assured, practical, patient, disciplined and faithful, a good advisor who finds solutions. You speak few words with authority, keep a small circle, and believe in live and let live.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-005.say: You are open, friendly, deep and versatile, a planner and good communicator who loves travel and freedom. Your thoughts and moods can fluctuate, and you get bored easily.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-006.say: You are composed, authoritative, intellectual, responsible, loyal, calm and humorous, and you love home life. Take care of being impulsive, opinionated, critical, inflexible or argumentative.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-007.say: You may seem active and social, but inside you are quiet, shy, sensitive and introspective. Gentle and somewhat secretive, you take responsibility well.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-008.say: You are sociable, intelligent, adaptable, humorous and nurturing, and you love freedom, music, food and the arts. You can be over-ambitious or selfish, and you tire easily physically.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-009.say: You are open, progressive, intelligent, spiritual and imaginative, with a direct approach to life and strong intuition you often ignore. Take care of impatience and self-centredness.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-010.say: You have a pure heart and are creative, energetic, sociable, spiritual and a natural leader who values freedom. You can excel as a preacher, painter or writer, but may get distracted easily.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-011.say: You are cooperative, charismatic, intuitive and inspiring, nurturing people and gardens, and can be fortunate with money. Take care, as sudden losses or accidents are possible.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-012.say: You are honest, direct, intelligent, philosophical and logical, adaptable and joyful. Stay calm under stress to help prevent accidents.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-013.say: You are reliable, trustworthy, analytical and meticulous, and you keep your promises and put work first. Versatile and decisive, you love mystery; take care not to seem two-faced or to use people.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-014.say: You are confident, charming, creative and popular, and protective of your family. Slow and steady, you may face ongoing obstacles; avoid repeating mistakes and leaning on others emotionally.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-015.say: You are compassionate, romantic, very reliable and respected, with your own principles and a love of solitude. You suit roles like trainer, researcher or guru, but can be secretive, domineering or resist change.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-016.say: You are very intelligent, artistic and analytical, a perfectionist who is honest and loyal. You have good money sense but may under-earn, and can be stubborn, possessive or dictatorial.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-017.say: You are quirky and unconventional, curious, creative, humorous and intuitive. You can also come across as complex, directionless, sarcastic or cold.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-018.say: You stand for righteousness and know right from wrong; you are tenacious, loyal, compassionate, forgiving and spiritual. Take care of low motivation, self-pity and impatience.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-019.say: You are sensitive, intelligent, playful and charming, fiercely independent, with talent for writing, fashion or film. Take care that charm does not slip into deception, manipulation or unfaithfulness.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-020.say: You are curious, investigative and caring, always seeking knowledge and experience, but find it hard to express your feelings. Take care of being unfocused, unreliable or high-strung.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-021.say: You are warm, calm, helpful, loyal and patient, with a dual nature and belief in the divine. You can also be evasive, judgemental, sarcastic or secretive.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-022.say: You are a perfectionist and diligent learner, sincere, loyal, ethical and ambitious, seeking fame and respect. Take care of rigidity, pride and nervous tension; you are either devoted to your spouse or stay unmarried.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-023.say: You are likeable, resilient, reliable and loyal, with lifelong friends, and a faithful partner. Take care of obsessiveness, indecision, poor communication, depression and addictive tendencies.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-024.say: You are sociable, intelligent and adaptable, the life of the party, and you love travel and diverse people while challenging norms. You can get bored easily and lose focus.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-025.say: You are ambitious and business-minded with an impressive aura, hungry for reputation, financial security and fame. Always busy and talking work, you may seem aloof.

CHALDEAN-FIRST-LETTER-026.say: You are very versatile, emotional and intelligent, curious and quick to learn languages. Popular and diplomatic, you make friends easily and build lasting connections.
